summary: SDK 54 -> 57 + icon package migration regression PASS. App boots cleanly on Expo 57 / RN 0.86 with no red screen, no pageerror events, and no JS runtime errors in console. Custom LED splash (react-native-reanimated 4.5) plays and auto-fades. ICON MIGRATION VERIFIED: @react-native-vector-icons/ionicons auto-loads its font — 26 elements with computed font-family='Ionicons' render real glyphs (e.g. \uf355, \uf56d, \uf19a, \uf3ca) across the header gear (settings-button), lock/pin, section icons (airplane/navigate/partly-sunny/american-football/tv/trending-up/chatbox/time), chevrons on collapsible headers, the location pin under Weather, and the sync icon in SYNC & CONFIRM — no tofu / no empty icon slots (confirmed both by DOM inspection and by screenshots showing colored ionicons). Collapsible defaults correct: Flight Tracking + Weather open on cold load; SPORTS/PINNED FLIGHT/TV SHOWS/FINANCIAL TICKERS/CUSTOM MESSAGE/DISPLAY & TRANSITIONS/SYNC STATUS all collapsed (verified team-1-input NOT present until SPORTS tapped, then appears). Team validation still works after upgrade: ZZZ -> team-1-input-warning shown, NYY -> cleared. add-team-button -> team-3-input appears. Weather zip lookup resolves 28117 -> Mooresville, NC (35.5840, -80.8685). Theme switching (settings-button -> theme-blue) changes radius-value to rgb(47,111,237) and persists to localStorage theme_id_v1='blue'. app-version footer renders 'Info Wall v1.0.0 · Web'. Transitions preset-snappy -> hold-value='6s', fade-value='9/10' exactly as specified. toggle-countdown correctly hides/shows countdown-label-input. Map modal opens on coord-preview tap; map-zoom-in, map-zoom-out, map-type-toggle, mode-radius, and mode-polygon chips all render and are tappable (react-native-svg 15.15 runtime OK, no crash). payload-preview updates live on weather-toggle. BLE not flagged (native-only per instructions).

react_native_issues.issue: props.pointerEvents is deprecated in RN 0.86 / RN Web. AnimatedSplash uses the deprecated prop form. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/AnimatedSplash.tsx:98 (`pointerEvents="none"` on Animated.View). Migrate to style.pointerEvents. Cosmetic console warning only; not blocking.

action_items: (Low priority) In /app/frontend/src/components/AnimatedSplash.tsx line 98, replace prop `pointerEvents="none"` with `style={[StyleSheet.absoluteFill, styles.root, containerStyle, { pointerEvents: 'none' }]}` to silence the deprecation warning surfaced by RN 0.86 / react-native-web 0.21.
critical_code_review_comments: index.tsx is still >1800 lines. Not blocking for this regression, but the earlier suggestion to extract per-section components remains valid.

SDK 57 upgrade + icon-lib migration look clean: _layout.tsx correctly drops the old custom icon-font hook and relies on @react-native-vector-icons/ionicons registering its font via expo-font; the only expo-font-loaded fonts are the Rajdhani/IBMPlex/SpaceMono TTFs, which is what we want.
Reanimated 4.5 / react-native-svg 15.15 / expo-router 57 all initialize without runtime warnings beyond the pointerEvents deprecation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: SDK 57 build is behavior-equivalent to the last passing SDK 54 iteration. Icon font renders via @react-native-vector-icons/ionicons auto-load (font-family 'Ionicons' on plain <div> in web output — check computed style, not <svg>). Map coord-preview requires ~2-5s for zip -> geo to resolve before it appears; poll for the element. Splash auto-fades in ~3s (no tap-to-skip). BLE is native-only; do not test in web. Only console noise is the pointerEvents deprecation from AnimatedSplash.tsx:98.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no functional regressions from the SDK 54 -> 57 upgrade or the @expo/vector-icons -> @react-native-vector-icons/ionicons migration.
